about: Balance targets for tools/balance/balance-report.sh. Each target is a band on one report row (row = the key in balance-report.csv). Sources: ~/cm-incidents/systems-audit-2026-11-17/SYSTEMS-AUDIT.md (section 1 numbers and roadmap) and the batch-15 builder orders. min / max are inclusive unless maxExclusive is true. b16: a target may carry "bySize": {"8": {...}, "5": {...}} with min / max / maxExclusive for that team size (balance-report --team-size); a size without an entry uses the top-level band. 16 = Full Battle (480 s), 8 = 8v8 and 5 = Quick 5v5 (240 s clock, hatch at 120 s).

targets.label: Time to kill 3 to 6 s (median 1v1 matchup)
targets.source: batch-15 combat feel; game-design skill: TTK long enough to react and be rescued

targets.label: No class wins every duel
targets.source: audit section 1: the Warrior is the class that wins (0.58 to 0.69 of kills)

targets.label: Top-10 share of damage at most 0.50
Blowouts (2:1 on hill time) at most 0.15
Lead changes at least 5 a match (median)
Leader at half wins 0.60 to 0.80
targets.source: batch-15 comeback hut: a lead matters but is not final

targets.label: Dead or walking back after a respawn at most 0.28 of a match
targets.source: audit section 1: 37% or more spent dead or walking back (built per death: respawn wait + get-up + the walk back from the pad). Definition from PR #219 (batch 15 wave two): not alive, plus the walk back from the Respawn event until the first of hill radius + 6, a hit dealt or taken, a job (gathering or channelling a vein), 20 s, or death. The older row time.deadwalk.all (any alive, non-fighting, empty-handed movement off the hill) stays printed without a band: it counts ordinary map movement.

targets.label: Warrior share of all fighter damage at most 0.40
targets.source: batch-15 combat feel (PR #215: 0.437 at its head, control 0.609)

targets.label: Kaiju owner wins at most 0.70
targets.source: mechanics audit 2026-11-21: 0.883 with hut votes, ~0.627 with the comeback combo; the egg race should matter but not decide

targets.label: Side balance: Crimson wins 0.40 to 0.60 (regression watch: 0.570 at 8v8 in the audit)
targets.source: mechanics audit 2026-11-21 (map symmetry is not in this build; this row watches it)
